book.timemod.astronomer.page1: For years I have watched the sky. But it is not always today's sky. Sometimes stars shine that died long ago – or ones that are yet to be born.
book.timemod.astronomer.page2: Deep below, where the Warden sleeps, someone tapped into time itself. The ruins still hum. Four shards, they say, wake its hunger.
book.timemod.astronomer.page3: The Clockmaker built himself a workshop without a door. He never wanted to be disturbed again. Yet his work still ticks – bring it a clockwork, and it will answer.
book.timemod.astronomer.page4: There are gates: rings of chronite that turn until the year gives way. I saw forests that do not exist yet, cities of glass – and lizards as tall as towers.
book.timemod.astronomer.page5: If you read this: wind your watch. And never trust a time that is too quiet.
book.timemod.astronomer.title: The Astronomer's Notes

chronik.timemod.chronophage.text:
Four time core fragments on the phage altar wake the time eater.

It slows you down, drinks Chronon from your tools and sends time leeches after you. Its maw is mostly closed: almost nothing gets through. And it rewinds every wound as soon as the maw closes again.

Listen closely: before the maw opens, its clockwork winds up. Stop time right then! All hits during the stop land together when time moves on – and those wounds it cannot undo.

Reward: the phage heart.
chronik.timemod.chronophage.title: The Chronophage
chronik.timemod.clockmaker.text:
Place a clockwork on the clockwork altar in the workshop and the titan awakens.

His armor swallows half of every hit. Once he has taken enough, he jumps three seconds back in time – all wounds are gone. He cannot be stopped.

But in slow motion his chest door opens: the clockwork behind it takes double damage, and he cannot jump back. Brake Spring and Slow-Motion Pendulum are your best friends.

Dodge the gear saws. Reward: the clockwork core.
chronik.timemod.clockmaker.title: The Clockmaker
chronik.timemod.endgame.text:
Two things remain for full mastery over time.

• The Time Loop: if you die while carrying it, the world around you rewinds 10 seconds, and you with it. It costs 100k chronon, then it needs 30 minutes. A totem in your hand takes precedence, and nothing helps against /kill.

• The Infinity Time Cell holds a million chronon. Huge, but not infinite.

Good to know: at the Clockmaker's Bench the chronon of the ingredients passes into the result, and installed modules are returned to you.
chronik.timemod.endgame.title: Loop and Infinity
chronik.timemod.future.text:
The future grows out of the present. Travel to a year ahead and you find what you built today – the way the years left it.

• Torches and lanterns have gone out after a year. Wood rots full of holes, glass shatters, wool crumbles. Stone grows moss and cracks, iron rusts, copper turns green – waxed copper stays bright.

• Statics: whatever has lost its support collapses. First the roofs, then the bridges.

• Nature takes everything back: vines on the walls, moss on the floors, cobwebs in the corners, sand in the deserts, snow on open floors – and trees grow through collapsed houses. Fields turn to meadow, meadow to forest.

• Of your animals only bones remain. Their descendants roam wild nearby. Signs fade.

• Your chests hold what time left behind – as time echoes: visible, but they crumble at a touch. Only the time capsule truly carries things through time.

The future is not written: keep building today and it looks different on your next visit – except where you built in the future yourself. Soon the villages there will grow into cities, too.
chronik.timemod.future.title: The Future
chronik.timemod.intro.text:
With TIME you shape time itself. Every tool creates a time zone: inside, everything runs faster, slower, not at all – or backwards.

Fast-forward is real: in a 2× zone an animal walks exactly the path it would have walked in twice the time. Plants grow, furnaces smelt, water flows, redstone switches.

The power for this is called Chronon. Early tools are wound up like a clock instead. The stronger the effect, the higher the price.

This chronicle guides you from your first pocket watch to the guardians of time.
chronik.timemod.intro.title: Time Is Yours
chronik.timemod.letters.text:
What you do in the past stays there – otherwise there would be endless paradoxes. But two things outlast the years on purpose.

• The Time Capsule: fill it in the past and seal it with sneak + use. In the present it lies at the same spot, buried in the ground if need be. Its contents have aged: food has rotted, iron has rusted, copper turned green, wood, wool and paper have crumbled, tools are worn. Diamonds stay diamonds, gold stays gold. A capsule that has outlasted the years shimmers softly – so you can find it even in tall grass.

• The Time Seed: sprinkle it on a sapling in the past. In the present a tree stands there, as old as the journey was far – after a thousand years a giant with roots like walls. Anything older than twenty thousand years remains only as a petrified trunk, with amber inside.

Both avoid your buildings: no capsule and no tree destroys what you built in the present.
chronik.timemod.letters.title: Greetings to the Present
chronik.timemod.machine.text:
The Chronos Gate leads to other years: up to a thousand years into the future and up to 245 million years back.

How to build it:
• Stand 24 Chronos Gate Frames up as a ring: 7 × 7 blocks with rounded corners. Five at the bottom and top, five on each side, plus one block moved inward in every corner. 21 cells stay free inside.
• Place the Chronos Console no more than eight blocks away. It finds the ring by itself, then its gears turn.
• Put a time cell into the console or place condensers next to it. The console stores up to 500k chronon.

Use ◀ ▶ to choose the year and ◀◀ ▶▶ to jump a whole age (also with the arrow keys, with Shift). The longer the journey, the more it costs: 10k chronon and up, about 136k for the Triassic.

Charging takes ten seconds. Then the portal opens for half a minute and everyone can step through. The time stream carries you to the target year in a few seconds, to the same place in the world. Whoever picks the same year meets you there.

Where you arrive, a Homeward Anchor appears. Use it and the stream carries you back in front of the gate. If the anchor is destroyed, it crumbles to dust: then you need a new gate or a self-built anchor, which leads to the present.

Distant ages need a focus in the console:
• Era Focus (Stone Age, Ice Age, Cenozoic): made from fossil fragments. You find them with a brush in suspicious sand and gravel.
• Focus: Mesozoic (dinosaurs): in the Pleistocene, a million years back, amber lies in the rock. Sometimes a mosquito is trapped inside. With a glass bottle it becomes a DNA sample.
chronik.timemod.machine.title: The Time Machine
chronik.timemod.paradox.text:
Far out in the outer End floats the Timeless Citadel: an island with a plaza like a clock face, a tower of purpur and, at the very top, an arena with the Mirror Altar.

Offer the mirror a Paradox time cell holding at least 50k chronon. Then your own echo faces you, with copies of your armor and your best weapon.

• It stops time and lays a ring of knives around you. As soon as time moves on, they fly. In full Chrono armor you can still move.
• It blinks behind you and throws fans of knives.
• It mirrors your time zones: slow or stop it and you hit yourself. Rewinding heals it.
• Below half health it calls fragile echoes.

Defeated, it leaves the Heart of Time behind, the core of the Chronos Watch.
chronik.timemod.paradox.title: Paradox – Your Echo
chronik.timemod.places.text:
• Decayed clock towers stand alone on plains and in forests. Up in the clock room there is often a map to the Timeless Workshop.

• Forgotten observatories crown the mountains. Read the astronomer's notes.

• Chrono ruins lie in the deep dark, full of chronite. In their chests: time core fragments. Careful, the Warden sleeps lightly.

• The Timeless Workshop has no door. Dig your way in – and wake the Clockmaker.

• The Timeless Citadel floats far out in the outer End. Your own echo waits there.
chronik.timemod.places.title: Places of Time
chronik.timemod.subtitle: Contents
chronik.timemod.tier1.text:
Brass: three copper ingots and one gold ingot make four brass ingots.

Build the Clockmaker's Bench (crafting table, brass, planks). There you make gears, mainsprings, balance wheels and the clockwork – the heart of every time tool.

Tier I tools run on spring tension: sneak and hold right-click to wind them up.

• Pocket Watch: time, moon and the flow of time where you stand.
• Growth Hourglass: one block runs 4× as fast for 30 s.
• Brake Spring: a creature runs at half time for 10 s.
• Moment Lens: freezes a creature, a projectile or a block for 3 s.
• Recall Watch: jump 5 seconds back – your path and health as they were.
chronik.timemod.tier1.title: Tier I – The Clockmaker
chronik.timemod.tier2.text:
Deep in the deepslate, chronite ore flickers through time. You can only mine it while it is there – a Moment Lens holds it in place.

Raw chronite becomes time dust in a blast furnace. With time sand and bone meal it becomes a chronite seed: it grows into crystals very slowly. In an accelerated zone it is much faster!

The Time Condenser burns crystals into Chronon (or sacrifices experience: sneak + right-click) and charges tools and time cells. Cells in your inventory refill your tools automatically.

The Time Field Projector keeps a zone running permanently – perfect for farms. Right-click changes the factor, sneaking the radius, redstone switches it off.
chronik.timemod.tier2.title: Tier II – Chronite
chronik.timemod.tier2_tools.text:
• Stasis Watch: time stands still within 12 blocks. Only you can move. Hits on frozen targets all land at once when time moves on.
• Time Accelerator: a zone with 2–4× time where you look.
• Slow-Motion Pendulum: 0.5× or 0.25×.
• Rewind Spool: while you carry it, the world remembers everything. One click visibly rewinds the area – destroyed blocks return, animals walk backwards.
• Chrono Knives: thrown in stopped time, they hang in the air.

Sneak + right-click changes the factor of accelerator and pendulum.
chronik.timemod.tier2_tools.title: Chronite Tools
chronik.timemod.tier3.text:
The Temporal Workbench only awakens between four Chrono Pillars: two stacked, diagonally two blocks away from the bench. Then its rings begin to spin. To build it you need the Clockmaker's clockwork core.

Insert a tier II tool and install modules:
• Filters decide what it affects: animals, monsters, growth, machines …
• Amplifiers: radius, duration, strength (up to 10× or 0.05×) and efficiency.

Example: an accelerator with the growth filter – only the plants race, the cows don't.

When rewinding, blocks, machines and items only go back together, along with your inventory – otherwise anything could be duplicated. Other filters only move and heal: the dead stay dead.
chronik.timemod.tier3.title: Tier III – Temporal Engineering
chronik.timemod.tier3_gear.text:
Chrono armor is made at the smithing table from netherite armor, a chronite plate and the smithing template (from the phage heart). Enchantments are kept.

Each piece saves 5% Chronon. The helmet shows every time zone as an outline. With the full set you move in other people's stopped time.

The Lifetime Extractor drains the time of creatures nearby: they fade, slow down and die of old age. Their lifetime becomes Chronon – a mob farm for time!

The Paradox Cell stores 100,000 Chronon.
chronik.timemod.tier3_gear.title: Armor and Lifetime
chronik.timemod.tier4.text:
The Chronos Watch unites everything: time stop, fast-forward, slow motion and rewind, every filter and – with enough mastery – the whole world. You build it at the Clockmaker's Bench from four tier II tools, both boss cores, a nether star, a strength module and the Heart of Time.

• R opens the radial menu: mode, filters, radius, duration, global.
• Sneak + mouse wheel: stop duration, factor or how far back.
• Sneak + use cancels your time zones.

Rewinding: hold the button – the world runs backwards while you stand still. Let go and it stays exactly there, and you get back what you did not use. Your inventory follows the world, and spent Chronon never returns. The timeline shows how far the world remembers; a ghost path shows where you have been.

Every use brings mastery: longer stops, larger radii, deeper rewinds and lower costs. From "Time Walker" on, the watch affects the whole world.
chronik.timemod.tier4.title: Tier IV – Lord of Time
